title: Contact
description: Contact entry in an address book or CRM system with personal information, company details, job title, location, notes, and tags. Used for contact management, CRM systems, and address books.

company.description: Company or organization the contact works for

job_title.description: Job title or position of the contact

city.description: City where the contact is located

country.description: Country where the contact is located

notes.description: Additional notes or information about the contact

tags.description: Array of tags for categorization (e.g., client, friend, colleague)

created_at.description: Timestamp when the contact was added
